about: dapp-17, r9, r10: the chain a site with no chain of its own starts on (network_space::site_start_chain_for). space_chain_ids: the space in front's networks in the wallet's list order; last_used: the network the person last put a site on in this space (null: none); account_chains: where the signed-in account holds something or used, most telling first. Read by vela-core (tests/site_start_chain_vectors.rs) and by the extension worker's twin (extension/lib/protocol.js siteStartChain / startChainOf, in src/lib/dapp/protocol.test.ts), so the two cannot drift.
